entries.label: Share of substantive compliance cost that produces unmeasured benefits
entries.units: share of the change in compliance cost (0 to 1)

citation.title: Forward plan: prospective policy costing in ALICIA

entries.quote: Share of substantive compliance producing unmeasured benefits: user-set, default 0 (D)
entries.derivation: The plan's default: s = 0, so the whole change in compliance cost is treated as producing no measured output. No range: the user sets s.
entries.notes: The tool's assumption, graded D because no source measures the share. s = 0 makes F-C1-01 an upper bound (interpretation A-P01): any compliance work that produces benefits national accounts do not measure would lower the MFP effect. Users should set s where the obligation has a clear unmeasured benefit (for example, safety).
